name: citation
purpose: An inline reference in generated text (`[1]`), Cloudscape's inline citation: a small rounded chip holding the source's site (`azion.com`), or its title cut to fit, that links to item `n` of the `Sources` list or to the URL, with a tooltip naming the source and the accessible name `Source 1, azion.com: <title>`. `StreamingResponse` renders it for every `[n]`, filling `site` from the source's `href`.
useWhen: A statement in a generated response that comes from a specific source.
avoidWhen: A link the reader is meant to follow as part of the prose → a normal link.
bestPractices: Number in order of first use: [1], [2], [3]; the number stays in the accessible name.
Give every citation a `title` and, for a web source, its `site`; a bare number tells a reader nothing.

props.name: index
props.doc: 1-based number of the source, in the order the response first cites it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Title of the source, shown in the tooltip and read in the accessible name; the chip shows it, cut to fit, when `site` is empty.

props.name: site
props.doc: Site of the source without `www.` (`example.com`), the text of the chip.

props.name: href
props.doc: Where the reference points: `#<anchor>-source-<n>` for the `Sources` list under the response, or the source URL. Without it, or when it is unsafe (`javascript:`, `data:`), the chip is plain text.
